description: Wind turbine telemetry for predictive maintenance

fields.name: vibration_x
fields.label: Vibration X-Axis
fields.description: Gearbox accelerometer reading along the X-axis

fields.name: vibration_y
fields.label: Vibration Y-Axis
fields.description: Gearbox accelerometer reading along the Y-axis

fields.name: vibration_z
fields.label: Vibration Z-Axis
fields.description: Gearbox accelerometer reading along the Z-axis

fields.name: power_output
fields.label: Power Output
fields.description: Electrical power output of the turbine

fields.name: wind_direction
fields.label: Wind Direction
fields.description: Wind direction relative to nacelle orientation

fields.name: ambient_temperature
fields.label: Ambient Temperature
fields.description: Environmental air temperature at hub height

fields.name: nacelle_vibration_rms
fields.label: Nacelle Vibration RMS
fields.description: Root-mean-square vibration of the nacelle structure

fields.name: power_residual
fields.label: Power Residual
fields.description: Actual power minus expected power from the wind speed power curve model

fault_types.name: gearbox_wear
fault_types.description: Gradual gearbox degradation causing oil temperature drift and vibration increase uncorrelated with load

fault_types.name: bearing_fault
fault_types.description: Bearing defect producing periodic high-frequency vibration spikes independent of wind speed and RPM

fault_types.name: yaw_misalignment
fault_types.description: Nacelle not tracking wind direction correctly, causing power output below the expected power curve without sensor faults
